This will generate new intermediate CA certificates from the current ones, signed by the root CA and using the existing key pairs. The subject and the key identifier of each certificate stay the same, so the existing issuer certificates remain valid and the key identifiers trusted by the licensing code do not change. Only the validity period and the serial number change.

The new certificates replace the current ones in the certificate store (the private keys are not modified). The current certificates are first saved in $escapetool.xml($backupReference).
